records.label: spacr.qt.model_install#1
records.source: Two kinds of thing are installed from a click: a segmentation backend, which is a Python package added to the running environment with ``pip`` (DINOCell and SAMCell, :data:`spacr.model_zoo.INSTALLABLE_BACKENDS`), and a Cellpose checkpoint from the model zoo, which is a file downloaded and verified by :func:`spacr.model_zoo.install`. Both can take minutes, so both run off the GUI thread: :class:`PackageInstall` runs ``pip`` as a child process watched from the event loop, and :class:`CheckpointDownload` runs the zoo's download on a worker thread. Each reports progress while it runs and a single result when it ends, and a failure is a message rather than an exception, so a failed install leaves the screen that started it working.
records.context: Two kinds of thing are installed from a click: a segmentation backend, which is a Python package added to the executing environment with ``pip`` (DINOCell and SAMCell, :data:`spacr.model_zoo.INSTALLABLE_BACKENDS`), and a Cellpose checkpoint from the model zoo, which is a file downloaded and verified by :func:`spacr.model_zoo.install`. Both can take minutes, so both run off the main GUI execution path: :class:`PackageInstall` runs ``pip`` as a child process watched from the event loop, and :class:`CheckpointDownload` runs the zoo's download on a background execution unit. Each reports progress while it executes and a single result when it ends, and a failure is a message rather than an exception, so a failed install leaves the application view that started it working.

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#1
records.source: A night theme is one choice that moves three things at once: the colours the interface is painted in (:data:`spacr.qt.theme.THEMES` grows by ten because of this module), which ambient animation runs behind it and in which colours (:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`), and which set of sounds spaCR plays if the user has ever switched sound on (:mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`). Choosing one in Preferences therefore changes how spaCR looks *and* how it sounds, which is the whole point of the family.
records.context: A night theme is one choice that moves three things at once: the colours the interface is painted in (:data:`spacr.qt.theme.THEMES` grows by ten because of this module), which ambient animation runs behind it and in which colours (:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`), and which set of sounds spaCR plays if the user has ever switched sound on (:mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`). Choosing one in Preferences therefore changes how spaCR looks *and* how it sounds, which is the whole point of the family.
records.translation: रात्रि थीम एक ऐसा विकल्प है जो एक साथ तीन चीज़ें बदलता है: वे रंग जिनमें इंटरफ़ेस पेंट होता है (इस मॉड्यूल के कारण :data:`spacr.qt.theme.THEMES` में दस जुड़ते हैं), इसके पीछे कौन-सा परिवेशी एनिमेशन किन रंगों में चलता है (:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`), और यदि उपयोगकर्ता ने कभी ध्वनि चालू की हो तो spaCR कौन-सा ध्वनि सेट बजाता है (:mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`)। इसलिए Preferences में इनमें से एक चुनना बदलता है कि spaCR कैसा दिखता है *और* कैसा सुनाई देता है, और इस परिवार का पूरा उद्देश्य यही है।

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#2
records.source: This module is Qt-free on purpose, the same way :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` is: :mod:`spacr.qt.preferences` imports it to validate a stored theme name and must not pull QtGui or QtWidgets in while doing so. It holds data and three lookups and imports nothing from the rest of spaCR, so :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`, :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient` and :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` can all read from it without a cycle.
records.context: This module is Qt-free on purpose, the same way :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` is: :mod:`spacr.qt.preferences` imports it to validate a stored theme name and must not pull QtGui or QtWidgets in while doing so. It holds data and three lookups and imports nothing from the rest of spaCR, so :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`, :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient` and :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` can all read from it without a cycle.
records.translation: यह मॉड्यूल जानबूझकर Qt-मुक्त है, उसी तरह जैसे :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`: :mod:`spacr.qt.preferences` संग्रहीत थीम नाम सत्यापित करने के लिए इसे आयात करता है और ऐसा करते समय उसे QtGui या QtWidgets नहीं लाने चाहिए। इसमें डेटा और तीन खोज फ़ंक्शन हैं और यह spaCR के बाकी हिस्से से कुछ भी आयात नहीं करता, इसलिए :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`, :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient` और :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` सभी बिना चक्र के इससे पढ़ सकते हैं।
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#3
records.source: THE PALETTES ARE LITERALS RATHER THAN A RECIPE. Each one was generated from a hue and a saturation over a shared lightness ramp, then checked against :func:`spacr.qt.theme.contrast_failures` and :func:`spacr.qt.theme.page_separation_failures` and written down. Keeping the numbers here rather than the recipe means the published colours are the reviewed colours, no solver runs at import, and ``tests/qt/test_ten_night_themes.py`` judges what actually ships.
records.context: The palettes are literals rather than a recipe. Each one was generated from a hue and a saturation over a shared lightness ramp, then checked against :func:`spacr.qt.theme.contrast_failures` and :func:`spacr.qt.theme.page_separation_failures` and written down. Keeping the numbers here rather than the recipe means the published colours are the reviewed colours, no solver runs at import, and ``tests/qt/test_ten_night_themes.py`` judges what actually ships.
records.translation: पैलेट विधि नहीं, बल्कि लिटरल हैं। हर एक एक साझा चमक-क्रम पर एक रंगत और संतृप्ति से बनाया गया, फिर :func:`spacr.qt.theme.contrast_failures` और :func:`spacr.qt.theme.page_separation_failures` के विरुद्ध जाँचा गया और लिख लिया गया। विधि के बजाय संख्याएँ यहाँ रखने का अर्थ है कि प्रकाशित रंग ही समीक्षित रंग हैं, आयात के समय कोई सॉल्वर नहीं चलता, और ``tests/qt/test_ten_night_themes.py`` वही आँकता है जो वास्तव में जारी होता है।

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#4
records.source: THREE COLOURS WERE MOVED OFF THE RECIPE BY MEASUREMENT, and they are the only three. Nocturne's and Aphelion's ``accent_lo`` failed ``bg`` against ``accent_lo`` at 4.5:1 undressed — a deep blue and a deep violet are simply too dark at the recipe's lightness — and Vesper's failed it at 4.49:1 at one of the sixty hue offsets the ``spaceout`` dressing can reach. All three were raised until they passed, and nothing else was touched. See ``docs/notes/spacr/qt/night_themes.md``.

All three were raised until they passed, and nothing else was touched. See ``docs/notes/spacr/qt/night_themes.md``.
records.translation: तीन रंग माप के आधार पर विधि से हटाए गए, और केवल यही तीन। Nocturne और Aphelion का ``accent_lo`` बिना सजावट के 4.5:1 पर ``bg`` बनाम ``accent_lo`` में विफल हुआ — गहरा नीला और गहरा बैंगनी विधि की चमक पर बस बहुत गहरे हैं — और Vesper का ``spaceout`` सजावट द्वारा पहुँचे जा सकने वाले साठ रंगत-ऑफ़सेट में से एक पर 4.49:1 पर विफल हुआ। तीनों को तब तक ऊँचा किया गया जब तक वे पास नहीं हो गए, और कुछ और नहीं छुआ गया। ``docs/notes/spacr/qt/night_themes.md`` देखें।

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#5
records.source: THREE ROLES ARE THE SAME IN ALL TEN, and deliberately: ``success``, ``warning`` and ``error``. records.label: spacr.qt.notify.announce_pipeline_finished#2
records.source: The run sound is asked for only when :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` is already loaded, which it is exactly when sound has been switched on: the engine is built by ``apply_sound_preferences`` at launch and after every Save, and without an engine :func:`spacr.qt.sound.announce_run_end` is a no-op anyway. Importing it here unconditionally cost 20.4 ms on the GUI thread at the first run that ended, for a user who had never asked for sound.
records.context: The run sound is asked for only when :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` is already loaded, which it is exactly when sound has been switched on: the engine is built by ``apply_sound_preferences`` at launch and after every Save, and without an engine :func:`spacr.qt.sound.announce_run_end` is a no-op anyway. Importing it here unconditionally cost 20.4 ms on the main GUI execution path at the first run that ended, for a user who had never asked for sound.
records.translation: रन ध्वनि केवल तब माँगी जाती है जब :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` पहले से लोड हो, जो ठीक तब होता है जब ध्वनि चालू की गई हो: इंजन लॉन्च पर और हर Save के बाद ``apply_sound_preferences`` द्वारा बनाया जाता है, और इंजन के बिना :func:`spacr.qt.sound.announce_run_end` वैसे भी कुछ नहीं करता। इसे यहाँ बिना शर्त आयात करने में, पहले समाप्त हुए रन पर, GUI थ्रेड पर 20.4 ms लगते थे, उस उपयोगकर्ता के लिए भी जिसने कभी ध्वनि नहीं माँगी।

records.source: spaCR already implements eight ways of finding an object -- ``otsu``, ``adaptive``, ``log``, ``dog``, ``ridge``, ``hysteresis``, ``cellpose`` and ``unet`` -- in :func:`spacr.object.generate_organelle_masks_sam`. records.label: spacr.qt.organelle_modes#2
records.source: THIS MODULE IS A BRIDGE AND NOT A SECOND IMPLEMENTATION. Every classical method runs through :func:`spacr.object._segment_single_image`, the one the organelle pipeline's workers call, and ``unet`` through :func:`spacr.object._segment_unet`. So "adaptive" means in Make Masks exactly what it means in a mask run, and a curator who tunes a block size on one field is tuning the setting the pipeline will read. The whole of this module's own work is naming the parameters, turning them into the ``organelle_*`` keys that engine reads, and saying what each method suits.
records.context: This module is a bridge and not a second implementation. So "adaptive" means in Make Masks exactly what it means in a mask run, and a curator who tunes a block size on one microscope field of view is tuning the setting the workflow will read. The whole of this module's own work is naming the parameters, turning them into the ``organelle_*`` structured-data names that engine reads, and saying what each method suits.

records.label: spacr.qt.organelle_modes#3
records.source: WHICH MORPHOLOGY A MODE RUNS UNDER. The organelle engine dispatches on ``organelle_morphology`` FIRST and the method second, because the same word means different code for different shapes. records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.resolve_effective_theme#1
records.source: Resolves an explicitly chosen ``"system"`` to the operating system's colour scheme as Qt reports it (``QStyleHints.colorScheme``), and to dark when Qt can't tell. It does not read the application palette: that is spaCR's own once a theme has been applied, so it would answer with whatever was applied last. Every other value passes through, so callers that only understand light/dark should compare against ``"light"`` and treat everything else as dark (Space and Cell are dark themes).
records.context: Resolves an explicitly chosen ``"system"`` to the operating system's colour scheme as Qt reports it (``QStyleHints.colorScheme``), and to dark when Qt can't tell. It does not read the application palette: that is spaCR's own once a theme has been applied, so it would answer with whatever was applied last. Every other value passes through, so callers that only understand light/dark should compare against ``"light"`` and treat everything else as dark (Space and Cell are dark themes).
records.translation: स्पष्ट रूप से चुने गए ``"system"`` को ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम की रंग योजना में हल करता है, जैसा Qt उसे बताता है (``QStyleHints.colorScheme``), और Qt न बता सके तो dark में। यह एप्लिकेशन पैलेट नहीं पढ़ता: थीम लागू होने के बाद वह spaCR का अपना होता है, इसलिए वह वही उत्तर देता जो आख़िरी बार लागू हुआ। हर अन्य मान आगे जाता है, इसलिए जो कॉलर केवल light/dark समझते हैं उन्हें ``"light"`` से तुलना करनी चाहिए और बाकी सब को dark मानना चाहिए (Space और Cell dark थीम हैं)।

records.label: spacr.qt.resonance#2
records.source: **The measurement.** :func:`analyse` turns a rendered WAV into a few hundred kilobytes of envelope, four band energies, a spectral centroid and an onset strength, sixty times a second, and :func:`ensure_analysis` keeps that beside the WAV so it is computed once and read thereafter. :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` does the computing on its own audio thread when it loads the music bed, and records what is playing and when it started (:func:`set_now_playing`); the backdrop reads the small arrays and the clock. **Nothing here listens to the machine.** There is no system-audio capture anywhere in spaCR and there is not going to be: the only sounds this can see are the ones spaCR is playing and the file the user chose.
records.context: **The measurement.** :func:`analyse` turns a rendered WAV into a few hundred kilobytes of envelope, four band energies, a spectral centroid and an onset strength, sixty times a second, and :func:`ensure_analysis` keeps that beside the WAV so it is computed once and read thereafter. :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` does the computing on its own audio thread when it loads the music bed, and records what is playing and when it started (:func:`set_now_playing`); the backdrop reads the small arrays and the clock. **Nothing here listens to the machine.** There is no system-audio capture anywhere in spaCR and there is not going to be: the only sounds this can see are the ones spaCR is playing and the file the user chose.
records.translation: **माप।** :func:`analyse` रेंडर की गई WAV को कुछ सौ किलोबाइट के आवरण, चार बैंड ऊर्जाओं, एक स्पेक्ट्रल केंद्रक और एक आरंभ-शक्ति में बदलता है, सेकंड में साठ बार, और :func:`ensure_analysis` इसे WAV के बगल में रखता है ताकि यह एक बार गणना हो और फिर पढ़ा जाए। :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` संगीत पृष्ठभूमि लोड करते समय यह गणना अपने ऑडियो थ्रेड पर करता है, और दर्ज करता है कि क्या बज रहा है और कब शुरू हुआ (:func:`set_now_playing`); पृष्ठभूमि छोटे ऐरे और घड़ी पढ़ती है। **यहाँ कुछ भी मशीन को नहीं सुनता।** spaCR में कहीं भी सिस्टम-ऑडियो कैप्चर नहीं है और नहीं होगा: यह केवल वही ध्वनियाँ देख सकता है जो spaCR बजा रहा है और वह फ़ाइल जो उपयोगकर्ता ने चुनी।

records.label: spacr.qt.resonance#5
records.source: WHY A LATTICE AND NOT AN EVALUATION PER PARTICLE. Eight relaxation rounds over 1 300 particles is 10 400 evaluations of eight trigonometric functions each if the field is evaluated where the particle is; on a 128x128 lattice it is four outer products, once, and then 10 400 integer lookups. Measured on this machine, eight rounds over 1 300 particles: 0.61 ms with the lattice against 0.76 ms without it, which is a modest 1.26x -- the point is not the ratio today but that the FIELD's share stops depending on the particle count at all, so density can be raised without the trigonometry following it.
records.context: Why a lattice and not an evaluation per particle. Eight relaxation rounds over 1 300 particles is 10 400 evaluations of eight trigonometric functions each if the field is evaluated where the particle is; on a 128x128 lattice it is four outer products, once, and then 10 400 integer lookups. Measured on this machine, eight rounds over 1 300 particles: 0.61 ms with the lattice against 0.76 ms without it, which is a modest 1.26x -- the point is not the ratio today but that the FIELD's share stops depending on the particle count at all, so density can be raised without the trigonometry following it.
records.translation: प्रति कण गणना के बजाय जाली क्यों। 1 300 कणों पर आठ विश्रांति चक्र, यदि क्षेत्र वहीं गणना हो जहाँ कण है, तो आठ त्रिकोणमितीय फ़ंक्शनों वाली 10 400 गणनाएँ हैं; 128x128 जाली पर यह एक बार चार बाह्य गुणनफल है, और फिर 10 400 पूर्णांक खोजें। इस मशीन पर मापा गया, 1 300 कणों पर आठ चक्र: जाली के साथ 0.61 ms और उसके बिना 0.76 ms, जो मामूली 1.26x है -- मुद्दा आज का अनुपात नहीं, बल्कि यह है कि क्षेत्र का हिस्सा कण गणना पर बिल्कुल निर्भर नहीं रहता, इसलिए घनत्व ऊँचा किया जा सकता है बिना त्रिकोणमिति के उसके पीछे चले।
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.resonance#6
records.source: AND WHY THE FIGURE IS RECOMPUTED FROM A FIXED START EVERY FRAME RATHER THAN CARRIED FORWARD. Every ambient engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)`` -- ``test_the_clock_alone_decides_the _frame`` steps one engine twelve times and jumps another straight to the same clock and demands the same picture, and ``test_the_backdrop_survives_a_run`` shades the same clock on two threads and compares the bytes. A particle simulation carried forward from frame to frame satisfies neither. Relaxation from a seeded start does, costs 0.61 ms, and has the better behaviour besides: the figure always belongs to the sound that is playing now rather than to the last few seconds of it.
records.context: And why the figure is recomputed from a fixed start every frame rather than carried forward. Every ambient engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)`` -- ``test_the_clock_alone_decides_the _frame`` steps one engine twelve times and jumps another straight to the same clock and demands the same picture, and ``test_the_backdrop_survives_a_run`` shades the same clock on two threads and compares the bytes. A particle simulation carried forward from frame to frame satisfies neither. Relaxation from a seeded start does, costs 0.61 ms, and has the better behaviour besides: the figure always belongs to the sound that is playing now rather than to the last few seconds of it.
